# Fixtures

- `synthetic-questions.json` — bundled, fully fictional evaluation data: 12 topics × 8 questions plus one repeated question per topic. No real credentials, device IDs, store names, member data, or customer information.
- `real-questions.json` — **not included**. If present locally, it is ignored by `.gitignore`; do not commit or publish it. Tests must not depend on it.
